elements_selected.content: Create src/reason.rs (or src/reason/mod.rs) gated behind #[cfg(feature = "reason")]. Implement the theory construction pipeline from SPEC-005 §5.5: 1) Parse — feed each SplBlock.content to spindle-parser, collect rules/facts/superiority/diagnostics, 2) Annotate provenance — attach _source_file, _source_line, _source_page metadata to each rule/fact via spindle-core Meta API (per ADR-007), 3) Combine — union all fragments into a single spindle-core Theory, detect duplicate rule labels (warn), 4) Validate — check undefined labels in (prefer ...), body literals with no matching head/fact (warn), 5) Reason — run spindle-core StandardReasoner, produce conclusions (+D/-D/+d/-d) for every literal, 6) Annotate conclusions — trace proof sources from rule metadata into ProvenancedConclusion structs. Key function: build_theory(spl_blocks: &[SplBlock]) -> Result<TheoryResult> where TheoryResult contains the Theory, conclusions, and diagnostics. Handle parse errors gracefully: exclude errored blocks, continue with partial theory, collect diagnostics.
